title: Curly braces: a window into JavaScript

slides.say: Curly braces open a window from your markup into JavaScript.
Inside curly braces you can put any JavaScript expression: a variable, or even a function call like format date.

slides.text: Use them in two places only: as text inside a tag, or as an attribute value right after =.
slides.say: But you can only use them in two places. As text inside a tag, or as an attribute value, right after the equals sign.

slides.code: // ✅ variable // 🔴 a string <{tag}>Hi // 🔴 not allowed
slides.say: Src equals curly avatar reads the variable. Put quotes around it and you pass the text, curly avatar. And a curly brace as a tag name does not work.

slides.text: Quotes pass a string. Curlies pass JavaScript.
slides.say: Takeaway: quotes pass a fixed string. Curly braces pass JavaScript.
